President Trump on Tuesday questioned the purpose of the United Nations as he addressed the General Assembly, claiming all the body did was write “strongly worded letters” and speak in “empty words.”   “What is the purpose of the United Nations?” the president asked during the organization’s 80th anniversary.   The president claimed he had resolved seven “unendable wars” since reassuming office, claiming the U.N. hadn’t done anything to help.   “It’s too bad that I had to do these things instead of the United Nations doing them,” he said. “And sadly, in all cases, the United Nations did not even try to help in any of them.”   President Trump said he deserved a Nobel Peace Prize for each of the seven conflicts, but that the real prize was saving lives.   “What I care about is not winning prizes, it’s saving lives,” he said.   He also lamented that he didn’t win a bid to renovate the U.N. building in Manhattan in the early 2000s, before he became president.   “As far as I’m concerned, frankly, looking at the building and getting stuck on the escalator, they still haven’t finished the job,” he said. #trump #unitednations #unga #cspan

BREAKING: HAIR WE GO AGAIN?! Trump suddenly emerges with a bizarre new DARK ’DO – and the internet goes wild over his latest follicular folly!  Donald Trump has apparently embarked on another sweeping transformation – this one involving his legendary combover. The president emerged at Morristown Airport Friday with his famously yellowish locks looking decidedly less golden and considerably more ... brown. “What in the world is going on with Trump's hair?” journalist Aaron Rupar asked, sharing a Jim Watson/AFP photo of the mysterious new coiffure. The internet immediately got snippy. One commenter saw Moe Howard from the Three Stooges (and now we can’t unsee it!).  Another dug up an old Hair Club for Men ad. Someone else wondered whether Trump had tariffed the country that makes his usual hair supplies. And inevitably, somebody shopped a bird's nest into it. All of which might be dismissed as another bad hair day if Trump's follicles hadn't been providing their own running subplot lately.  Last month, his suddenly fuller-looking hair prompted another round of internet speculation.  Then, just days ago, Trump himself unexpectedly raised the subject and insisted: “I don't wear a wig.” Nobody had asked. We certainly don't know what caused Friday's new look. Hair dye? Styling product? Lighting? A particularly ambitious comb? Natalie's idea? (Sorry.) Presidential privilege protects many secrets, and apparently some of them are follicular. But after a decade of that unmistakable yellow-blond swoop, the new brunette Trump is genuinely startling. Perhaps the explanation is perfectly ordinary. Or perhaps the famous combover has simply had it after all these years – it's time to dye with dignity.
